about: Every control in the Academic Reviewer live preview (project/RV.dc.html) of the FINAL owner-approved design, and the canvas index boards. 'in-role' controls change the view inside the one role-preview root and keep its state. 'anchor' controls move focus within the page. 'shared' controls reach the borrowed XS surfaces. 'external' links are sample vendor URLs (.example domains, deliberately unreachable) that open in a new tab. 'handoff' effects reach other roles only through the documented scenarios in HANDOFF.md and SCENARIOS.json. No control is an href="#" placeholder: in-role links use href="#rv-top" (a real anchor) plus a handler. Record IDs are no longer printed on any control label; routes still carry them.
